resource_type.description: The type of resources to watch, such as supplier. Each needs a web address.

unavailable_text.description: The words their page shows when an item is gone. Capitals don't matter.

notify_integration.description: The connection used to send the notification, such as Slack or Apprise (Settings → Integrations).

timezone.description: The time zone the daily schedule runs in, such as `America/New_York`.
